headline: Select all is a symbol now, the colour bar stays pinned, and the scan report stopped lying about itself
notes: **The pinned colour swatches stay pinned.** A rebuild was destroying the pin every time, and the panel rebuilds hundreds of times in a working day — so the grid you pinned kept quietly unpinning itself while you worked.

**The swatch row goes back inline when you widen the panel.** It moved above the bar when you narrowed the dock and then stayed there, because the row's own width was only re-checked when a different threshold happened to be crossed.
**Select all in a sequence header is a double tick with its count beside it**, instead of a button the width of the sequence name. The pinned bar at the bottom keeps its words.
**⌘-click a second Select all to add that sequence to the selection** rather than replace it — the same gesture as ⌘ on a row, one level up.

**The scan report tells you three things it used to get wrong**: it no longer repeats one line sixteen times, it reports which modifier keys reached the panel separately from which ones a handler acted on, and it re-measures its own controls after the host has laid them out instead of reporting them as 0 by 0.
